# Get Rid Of Denver Metro

> Free local guide to disposing of specific items (tires, paint, mattresses, electronics and more) in Denver-metro cities, Colorado. One item, one city, one page, with official sources. Always confirm with the facility before you go.

## Pages
- [Home](https://getridof.ttawebdev.com/): Index of disposal guides by item and Denver-metro city.
- [Tires in Thornton, CO](https://getridof.ttawebdev.com/tires/thornton/): Where and how to get rid of old tires in Thornton, with costs and drop-off options.
- [Tires in Denver, CO](https://getridof.ttawebdev.com/tires/denver/): Where and how to get rid of old tires in Denver, with costs and drop-off options.
- [Tires in Aurora, CO](https://getridof.ttawebdev.com/tires/aurora/): Where Aurora residents can take old tires (no city pickup), with costs and drop-off options.
- [Tires in Westminster, CO](https://getridof.ttawebdev.com/tires/westminster/): Where Westminster residents can take old tires (no city pickup; Sustainability Center takes bike tires only), with costs and drop-off options.
